messages:

ash_prod: Bench bullets to call out: median latency ~80ms, ~2x cost savings with caching+quant, Dedicated pools for tail control. Short lines on slide.

pat_ops: Recording & stream start at 10:40. Join 10:25 for mic checks. On failover I'll post "OP: failover -> hosted-fallback" and cue the clip. I'll also post green/red statuses.
ivy_growth: Polls: minute 4 "Primary infra pain?" (latency/cost/scale/ops). Minute 22 "Want a sandbox?" yes/no. We'll tag leads by responses.

```
10:40 - recorder on + mic checks
11:00 - Welcome (maya) - 3m
11:03 - Bench narrative (ash) - 6m
11:09 - Live demo (leo) - 9m
11:18 - Deep dive & routing (ash) - 6m
11:24 - Q&A + poll review - 12m
11:36 - CTA & wrap (maya) - 4m
```
